title: Trained-vs-untrained energy correctness calibration on held-out GSM8K (v2)

field_provenance.honest_verdict: Terminal verdict must start with complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_.
field_provenance.n_candidates_heldout: Total held-out candidates scored across all CV folds.
field_provenance.untrained_energy_auroc_baseline: The exp3450 0.516 reference carried forward for comparison.
field_provenance.trained_energy_correctness_auroc: AUROC of P(correct) as a correctness classifier — the core number.
field_provenance.trained_energy_correctness_spearman: Rank-correlation of trained energy vs correctness.
field_provenance.fover_energy_correctness_auroc: AUROC of -fover_energy as a correctness classifier.
field_provenance.trained_energy_auroc_lift_over_untrained: trained_auroc - 0.516: does training fix the uninformative-energy ceiling?
field_provenance.within_problem_argmin_correct_rate_train: Fraction of problems where highest-P(correct) candidate is correct.
field_provenance.random_seed: Determinism: must match exp3460 seed so held-out split is identical.
field_provenance.reproducibility_checksum: Content hash of corpus + config + seed.

acceptance_gate_g1_energy_carries_signal.principle: G1 ENERGY-CARRIES-SIGNAL: a trained or FoVer energy carries meaningful correctness signal above the 0.516 untrained floor.

methodology_note: Same 5-fold problem-level CV as exp3460 (seed=20260601). Trained energy = P(correct) from fold-specific logistic reranker trained on all other folds' candidates. FoVer energy = arithmetic + contradiction + Curry-Howard + logical (parameter-free). All held-out candidates scored exactly once.
